summary: Base64 decoding pattern in express-mongo-limit without traced malicious use
details: src/index.cjs contains Buffer.from(..., "base64").toString(...) usage at lines 72 and 196. This pattern alone is common in legitimate code (decoding configuration values, tokens, or identifiers) and no traced code path shows fetch-and-execute of remote content, environment variable exfiltration, credential harvesting, or a hardcoded attacker-controlled network destination. No lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) were flagged, and no other suspicious primitives (child_process spawning of fetched content, obfuscated destinations, credential path reads) were identified.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
